books.title: The Left Hand of Darkness
books.author: Ursula K. Le Guin
books.blurb: An envoy from a interplanetary alliance is sent to a wintry world whose inhabitants have no fixed gender, forcing him to question everything he assumes about people and power.

books.title: Pachinko
books.author: Min Jin Lee
books.blurb: A Korean family's fortunes rise and fall across four generations in Japan, tracing how history moves through ordinary households.

books.title: Braiding Sweetgrass
books.author: Robin Wall Kimmerer
books.blurb: A botanist and Potawatomi elder weaves indigenous teaching with plant science to argue for a more reciprocal relationship with the living world.

books.title: The Fifth Season
books.author: N. K. Jemisin
books.blurb: On a continent wracked by catastrophic seismic ages, a mother searches for her daughter while the world ends around her, again.

books.title: Klara and the Sun
books.author: Kazuo Ishiguro
books.blurb: An artificial friend observes the world from a shop window, hoping to be chosen, and learns what humans mean by love.

books.title: Sapiens
books.author: Yuval Noah Harari
books.blurb: A sweeping account of how a mid-ranking primate came to reshape the planet, told through the shared myths that let strangers cooperate at scale.

books.title: Gilead
books.author: Marilynne Robinson
books.blurb: An aging Iowa preacher writes a long letter to his young son, setting down a family's history and his own quiet reckonings with faith.

books.title: The Warmth of Other Suns
books.author: Isabel Wilkerson
books.blurb: The decades-long migration of Black Americans out of the South, told through three individual lives that stand for millions of others.
